item.title: Event-Driven Workflows with Argo Events
item.description: 1. How Argo Events Works The diagram above is from the official Argo Events website. An event processing system has three important parts: Ingesting event sources, which corresponds to the Event Source Distributing events, which corresponds to the Event Sensor Consuming events, which corresponds to the Event Trigger The event messages are stored in the EventBus, which uses NATS by default.
